title: call-omp required_actions
description: Canonical, machine-readable contract for the OPTIONAL `required_actions` field in an OMP audit verdict. This schema is the single source of truth: validators MUST derive permitted kinds and all limits from this document rather than hard-coding them. Semantics: a `pass` severity carries NO required action and MUST map to []; `revise` means bounded, self-contained repair work the producer may loop on; `human_review` requires a human decision before continuing; `stop` prohibits automated loop continuation.

kind.description: revise = bounded repair work; human_review = requires a human decision; stop = prohibits automated loop continuation. (`pass` verdicts have no action and yield an empty array.)

reason.description: Non-empty human-readable justification for the action, max 512 characters.

targets.description: Optional 1–16 concrete targets (file:line, path, symbol). Each a non-empty string, max 256 characters.
